record_type_quote:
The work reported here is a rigorous conceptual replication of
the so-called “Correlation-Matrix” experiment by an independent author.

targets.title: Self-organization of temporal structures—A possible solution for the intervention problem.
targets.evidence_quote:
The conceptual replication of the CMM-type experiment of
the type performed before (von Lucadou, 2006; Walach et al., 2020)
(Experiment 1 as reported above) has yielded no evidence of anomalous correlations.
targets.outcome_quote:
The conceptual replication of the CMM-type experiment of
the type performed before (von Lucadou, 2006; Walach et al., 2020)
(Experiment 1 as reported above) has yielded no evidence of anomalous correlations.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The author explicitly identifies both the von Lucadou and Walach experiments as replicated by Experiment 1 and concludes no anomalous correlations. Earlier 1986/1991 studies are background predecessors rather than the button-push targets.

targets.title: Two attempted retro-priming replications show theory-relevant anomalous connectivity.
targets.evidence_quote:
Experiment 2 is a conceptual replication of the work
reported in Jolij and Bierman (2019).
targets.outcome_quote:
The second experiment in this study (Experiment 2), a conceptual replication of the work reported by Jolij and Bierman (2019), yielded
marginal evidence (p = .064) of anomalous connectivity—of the same
order of magnitude as found in Jolij and Bierman.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The author treats the marginal anomalous-connectivity evidence as agreeing with the original marginal result. Statistical significance alone does not decide success; the direct comparison does. This target is separate from the button-push targets.

reasoning: Complete 24-page published article including references acquired through web PDF extraction after direct download connections failed. Title, author, journal, DOI and boundaries match. Two experiments target three named papers independently; general CMM predecessors, RNG variants and analysis-method citations are not additional targets.
parser: web.run PDF text extraction; all 723 numbered lines assembled and verified
blind_source_warning: A general title search unexpectedly returned FORRT atlas snippets. Those pages were not opened, and snippets were not used as coding evidence. This incidental exposure compromises strict blinding for this work; all targets and outcomes above were independently derived from the complete primary paper.
